lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 올해 후원 사업 성과를 들어 볼까요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello. Shall we hear about this year's sponsorship results?
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo. olhae huwon saeop seonggwareul deureo bolkkayo?
lines.en: Yes, results were better than in past years.

lines.beaver_en: How much donation money was raised?
lines.learner: 기부금과 성금을 합쳐 삼천만 원이 모였습니다.
lines.en: Combining donations and public contributions, we raised 30 million won.
lines.roman: gibugeumgwa seonggeumeul hapchyeo samcheonman woni moyeotseumnida.

lines.beaver: 많이 모였네요. 어떤 활동이 도움이 됐나요?
lines.beaver_en: That's a lot. Which activity helped?
lines.beaver_roman: mani moyeonneyo. eotteon hwaldongi doumi dwaennayo?
lines.en: The charity bazaar played an important role.

lines.beaver_en: Who took part in the bazaar?
lines.learner: 자원봉사자 쉰 명과 협회 구성원들이 도왔습니다.
lines.en: Fifty volunteers and association members helped.
lines.roman: jawonbongsaja swin myeonggwa hyeopoe guseongwondeuri dowatseumnida.

lines.learner: 시민들의 관심이 높아서 성금이 날마다 늘었습니다.
lines.en: Public interest was high, so donations grew every day.
lines.roman: simindeurui gwansimi nopaseo seonggeumi nalmada neureotseumnida.

lines.en: Mostly low-income families and immigrant families.

lines.beaver_en: What's your view on the welfare system?
lines.en: Welfare systems alone aren't enough, so charity matters.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have plans to increase donors?
lines.learner: 꾸준한 기부자를 우대하고 고액 기부도 늘리겠습니다.
lines.en: We'll reward regular donors and increase large donations.
lines.roman: kkujunhan gibujareul udaehago goaek gibudo neulligetseumnida.

lines.learner: 개인주의와 이기주의를 넘어 함께 나누는 것입니다.
lines.en: Going beyond individualism and egoism to share together.
lines.roman: gaeinjuuiwa igijuuireul neomeo hamkke nanuneun geosimnida.

lines.beaver: 좋은 말씀 감사합니다. 협회도 계속 돕겠습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Thank you. The association will keep helping.
lines.beaver_roman: joeun malsseum gamsahamnida. hyeopoedo gyesok dopgetseumnida.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll report good results next year too.
